summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing Board approval to allocate up to BRL 4 billion for redeeming Class C preferred shares (PNC) during fiscal 2026. This is a preliminary budget estimate, not a binding commitment; specific redemption amounts and timing require future Board approval. The company is coordinating with B3 (Brazilian stock exchange) on operational procedures. As a pioneering transaction, the first conversion/compulsory redemption will likely cover only a portion of the allocated amount. Watch for subsequent Board resolutions and B3 timelines to gauge actual execution pace and potential share price support.
